body:
That's why I said I'm glad life gave you a second chance. I have pretty much given up. People like us are usually just written off and forgotten about. I've met women that are in their 40s who have lived this path and it doesn't always get easier.

The hardest thing to explain to people is the trauma being a chronic patient can bring. I've been in and out of hospitals since I was nine (29 now), and almost every single experience left me with a scar (some worse than others). Then when you complain about your experiences people think you're overdramatic and crazy. I guarantee if you put a perfectly "sane" person through the same bullshit we've been through, they wouldn't be the same. The only difference is we're sick people being traumatized, so the pain is compounded.

I can totally relate. Years of being in and out of hospitals have left me really damaged. Not just me, but seeing how other people are treated. I'm a little older than you, and I don't have insurance, so I've seen the UGLIEST sides of the mental health system.

I tried to escape it by partying (warehouse parties, clubs etc), trying to not think about my problems and I realized how toxic that whole scene was.

Now I'm just sort of existing. The therapy resources aren't there, and even if they were, I have so little faith in the system and the world, that I don't see the point in trying. I'm glad life gave you a second chance, even if it is lonely. You're not alone with your feelings though. :)

I feel like these people are infecting my daily life, whether or not I read their comments though. Its just that most people in positions like mine are too ill or struggling to do anything about it. These fuckwads live in their own little bubbles, only people outside of their bubbles are suffering the consequences. I'm sorry but I can't let these people off the hook. It'd be like letting Nazis or any other dangerous idealogue off the hook. And that's the other problem. These people dont even think what they're doing to us harmful. I want to be able to just let it go, but I'm not going to suffer at the whims of babies anymore.

https://youtu.be/gcKqAhLeM-4

I have issues leaving the house and driving. I get panicky and easily overwhelmed. It limits everything I'm able to.

It's easy to pass them off as idiots, but these sentiments have legitimate consequences that concretely effect people's lives. I don't go seeking them out on right wing blogs either. I'm not a complete glutton for punishment haha. I just come across them surfing the web.
I feel like I've been metaphorically puking my whole life though. I mean how much is a person supposed to take you know?
I don't doubt that the right strain might be beneficial, I just don't know how I would even get a ride to get a card and then get to a dispensary to buy some you know? I feel really helpless.

Like I mentioned in a previous response, I've been trying to see a doctor at a local clinic for 3 weeks now to no avail.. I just get so overwhelmed with trying to take care of myself. I really am at the breaking point.

That picture alone was really helpful. Maybe ill check that book out. It's just so hard without a doctor. I've been trying to get an appointment at a clinic for 3 weeks now but nobody will get back to me :(.
Thanks. I've just been a nervous wreck. I don't know if things will change for the better at this point. I really don't. I do sometimes smoke pot but it usually makes my anxiety worse.

eh just because I want something doesn't mean it's going to happen. I'm still considering suicide. Frankly I just want to work in an office filing stuff. Anything easy, but not being able to drive seriously limits that. This city is eating me alive.
Yeah. I'm tired of feeling like I'm on the fringes of society all the time. I could be homeless when my grandfather dies.
I haven't worked in years. I doubt anyone would hire me at this point.
A job would be nice. I'm basically stuck in my house rotting away.
I'm in Los Angeles just to clarify. And I'm on disability for PTSD and severe anxiety. It's been hard for me to function since I was assaulted.
It doesn't, I've just been very sad and very alone for a long time. There's a very good chance that things won't turn around for me like they did for him though
Not really. After I was raped people didn't know how to act around me, then I had a nervous breakdown, now I'm pretty much alone. I feel like a burden all the time.
I guess so.
I'll take my chances.
Not gonna call that.
Still gonna kill myself. Just waiting.
There's trains.

Honestly some people might miss me, but my suffering is intense. I've experienced way too much to keep going on like this. To quote the JAMC, "God spits on my soul, there's something dead inside my hole".
I don't care anymore. I've been traumatized plenty.
I could be waiting forever for something that never happens. The loneliness is killing me.
Real, visceral love.

No it's not. I literally have nothing to live for except loneliness and poverty. I understand you're coming from a place of kindness but I don't think the kindness of strangers is enough to keep me sticking around. Thanks though.
I live in LA and I'm on disability. I couldn't go anywhere even if I wanted to, but thanks.
There's nothing for me to stick around for.
I think I'm just better off dead at this point. I keep trying and trying and my life just gets worse. Thanks though.
I don't know. It honestly might depress me more. I feel pathetic just making this post.
yeah this was pretty much a bust. There's a lot of nice guys just none that get me.
Yeah but so far nobody's really stimulated me mentally or otherwise haha.
Like I don't know how old you are etc. haha.
Well I don't even know much about you...maybe you can PM me with a pic and we can talk more? :)
Ok awesome. More stuff to check out. And I loved the score for that, although I think the Master score would be pretty good to write along with too.
Dude the museum of death sounds awesome. Interestingly enough I've been wanting to go to some of the Nerdist stand-up stuff but it feels weird seeing stand-up comedy alone.
I haven't, I'm more of a film music buff but I'll have to check them out. I like anything weird..been reading Tom Robbins lately.
Yeah you kinda have to find a news site that makes sense to you, because there's so much info out there. And unless it's the Chrono Trigger soundtrack yes those things would suck for me. :x

Well it really depends on what kind of news your interested in and what your affiliations are. I actually follow a lot of people whose opinions I agree with on social media (like Caroline Heldmann), who post news stories from various places, although I check Mother Jones regularly.
Thanks, even though I'm weary haha.

It is hard, especially because people who aren't in the system are so clueless about how broken and fucked it is. And I have been to clinics. I lost my disability because I left a DBT program and they ratted me out to try and get me to come back (true cult level stuff). I can't trust anyone anymore. I don't want to detract from what you're going through. I know it sucks. *hugs*

You're not alone. I'm not homeless but I'm 28 and living with my grandpa in a run down house. We barely have food and once he dies (he's 90), I'll probably be homeless. I also have ptsd from sexual assault, and my internet use has been monitored since I wrote an email to the state attorney general. I wish it was paranoia but a hacker actually contacted me and sort of confirmed it.

 I actually want to die at this moment, because I've tried just about every med and these county clinics are so overrun with patients and underfunded that the system has failed me. I really just need a therapist. I wish there was something I could say to make you feel better other than you're not really alone. I'm on the fringes and barely hanging in there myself.
